fields.description: Season team attack rating word in the EEPROM save buffer
fields.evidence: FUN_08063538 reads 8-byte EEPROM blocks from DAT_0d000000 into the save buffer; this word carries the team attack rating.
fields.name: team_attack_rating

fields.description: Season team defense rating word in the EEPROM save buffer
fields.evidence: FUN_080635fc writes the save buffer back to EEPROM via DAT_0d000000; this word carries the team defense rating.
fields.name: team_defense_rating

fields.evidence: FUN_080637b4 verifies the stored buffer with a triple-vote read through FUN_080635e8 and FUN_0806375c; this counter holds season wins.
fields.name: season_win_count

fields.evidence: FUN_0806375c compares the EEPROM block read by FUN_08063538 against the expected buffer; this counter holds season losses.
fields.name: season_loss_count

fields.description: Gameplay option flags (difficulty, assists, rule toggles)
fields.evidence: FUN_0805cecc walks the EEPROM blocks 8 bytes at a time calling FUN_080637b4; this flags word stores gameplay options.
fields.name: gameplay_option_flags

fields.evidence: FUN_08063538 loads and FUN_080635fc stores the save buffer; this byte tracks the tournament stage index.
fields.name: tournament_stage

fields.evidence: FUN_0805cecc steps the save buffer in 8-byte blocks through FUN_080637b4; this double-word accumulates the career total score.
fields.name: career_score_total
